title: EXcommunity — getPrice() + CREATE2 Price Oracle Manipulation Analysis
root_cause: The Boy token's `getPrice()` function uses DEX pair spot reserves, allowing an attacker to manipulate reserves via `skim()` and then call `buy()` through 10 helper contracts deployed with CREATE2 to mint an excessive amount of Boy tokens at a distorted price
steps: → [3] Transfer Girl tokens to Boy/Girl pair
→ [5] Deploy 10 Money helper contracts via CREATE2
Manipulated low price → Boy tokens over-minted
